privacy: No player names, account IDs, absolute timestamps or match keys.
classification: Existing physical overlap followed by slow escape; not missing permission, exhausted stamina, or a missed due jump.

escapeWitness.meaning: Under each constant-velocity bracket, the same already-bounded heading monotonically increases existing separation at both speeds. The touching gate alone disallows prospective sprint.

limitations: The two bracket poses are independent geometry witnesses; the exact opponent pose at arbitration was not logged.
Measured normal movement is supported by position samples, not just reported velocity.
A separating-heading witness does not prove that an entire alternative route or catch would succeed.
Any future exception must preserve bounds, initially-clear bodies, measured-motion checks, and blocked/stationary/approaching rejection.
The lookahead uses bounded current opponent velocity, not a guarantee against future acceleration or a live catch result.
No outcome improvement rate is claimed from these geometry witnesses.

change.scope: Retain an already requested and opted-in native sprint only during a measured, strictly separating escape from moving near-contact bodies.
gates: Existing caller stamina budget and sprint opt-in remain required.
Measured travel must be at least 75% of normal run speed and at most 125% of the larger current/sprint speed. Reported velocity alone does not qualify.
Current native speed must be at least 95% of normal run speed; jammed movement remains excluded.
Every near-contact body must itself be moving at least 20% of normal run speed, with a minimum 2 studs/second.
At both current and prospective movement speeds, every near-body distance derivative must be strictly positive and endpoint separation must improve by at least 0.25 studs over the existing lookahead.
Every initially clear body retains the existing 4.25 stud sprint band in the default configuration.
Original bounded turning, same-side preference, obstacle evaluation, field bounds, and ordinary opt-out behavior remain in force.
notChanged: No speed or character property writes.
No catch, jump, dive, or server-claim validation changes.
No extra sprint request when the caller has not funded/requested one.

validation.positiveRegression: Recorded geometry brackets plus mirrored, rotated, translated fixtures check exact helper outputs, monotonic clearance at both speeds, bounded turning, and stable passing side.
validation.controllerBudgetIntegration: Owned by the independent controller reviewer; release validation runs the full controller suite.
